channel.title: WebLogic Deploy Tooling
channel.description: WebLogic Deploy Tooling WebLogic Deploy Tooling (WDT) makes it easy to stand up WebLogic environments and perform domain lifecycle operations in a repeatable fashion based on a metadata model that can be treated as source and evolve as the project evolves. Many organizations use WebLogic Server, with or without other Oracle Fusion Middleware components, to run their enterprise applications. And, as more and more of these organizations move toward Continuous Delivery of their applications, the importance of automated configuration application deployment grows. This automation is often implemented using the WebLogic Scripting Tool (WLST) configuration and deployment scripting language, but this is challenging. Such scripts must be carefully updated as the project evolves or the project is deployed to different environments, such as test to production.

item.title: Release Notes
item.description: Changes in Release 4.4.7 Major New Features Other Changes Bugs Fixes Known Issues Major New Features None Other Changes #1919 - Added support for September CSPUs. #1921 - Preserved order in the variables file on updates. #1923 - Added support for WLS 26.1 Foreign JNDI properties encryption. #1925 - Added support for October PSUs. #1926 - Added support for WLS 26.1 Foreign JMS properties encryption. #1928 - Upgraded to JLine 4.3.1 to eliminate CVE. Bug Fixes #1881 - Fixed Java properties file encoding issues when writing out the variables file. #1910 - Fixed issue with the alias type for JNDI allow lists to support lists. #1924 - Fixed an issue that could cause duplicate JdbcResource folders causing discovery to fail. #1927 - Fixed an issue with handling null shared library runtime references during online deployment (GitHub #1750). Known Issues SSH support requires a reasonably recent version of Bouncy Castle. WDT picks up Bouncy Castle from WLST so, for example, the 12.2.1.4.0 GA release fails with the following error, as mentioned at https://github.com/hierynomus/sshj/issues/895. Applying a recent PSU should resolve the issue for 12.2.1.4 and 14.1.1.
